::: text
My background spans upstream process development, synthetic biology, and metabolic engineering, coupled with a deep understanding of statistics/bioinformatics. I have research experience across biopharma (Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda), academic (UT Austin, MIT), and startup (BioReNuva) environments. I have worked across bacterial, yeast, and mammalian cell lines.

At BioReNuva I developed the company's first bioreactor fermentation process and led its transfer to manufacturing. My doctoral work in the Alper lab centered on the oleaginous yeast *Yarrowia lipolytica*: I developed Golden Gate based genome editing and promoter library screening, performed adaptive laboratory evolution to raise tolerance to industrial waste streams, and integrated CFD modeling of high-oil-density fermentations.

<script>
(function () {
  var list   = document.querySelector(".focus-areas .chips");
  var detail = document.getElementById("chip-detail");
  if (!list || !detail) return;

  var chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll(".chip"));
  if (!chips.length) return;

  var HINT    = detail.innerHTML;
  var pinned  = null;
  var showing = null;

  // Only touch the DOM when the content actually changes.
  function render(chip) {
    if (chip === showing) return;
    showing = chip;
    detail.innerHTML = chip ? chip.getAttribute("data-hl") : HINT;
    if (chip) detail.classList.remove("is-hint");
    else detail.classList.add("is-hint");
  }

  // Reserve the height of the tallest highlight so the panel never resizes
  // as you move between chips. Recomputed on resize, since wrapping changes.
  function reserveHeight() {
    var keepHTML = detail.innerHTML;
    var keepHint = detail.classList.contains("is-hint");
    detail.style.minHeight = "";
    detail.classList.remove("is-hint");
    // Measure fractionally: offsetHeight rounds to an integer and can under-reserve.
    var tallest = detail.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
      detail.innerHTML = chips[i].getAttribute("data-hl");
      var h = detail.getBoundingClientRect().height;
      if (h > tallest) tallest = h;
    }
    detail.innerHTML = keepHTML;
    if (keepHint) detail.classList.add("is-hint");
    detail.style.minHeight = Math.ceil(tallest) + "px";
  }

  function pin(chip) {
    pinned = chip;
    for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
      chips[i].setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(chips[i] === chip));
    }
    render(chip);
  }

  function chipFrom(node) {
    return node && node.closest ? node.closest(".chip") : null;
  }

  // Hover is delegated to the list, so moving from one chip to another
  // never fires a clear in between. That is what caused the flicker.
  list.addEventListener("mouseover", function (e) {
    var chip = chipFrom(e.target);
    if (chip && !pinned) render(chip);
  });
  list.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {
    if (!pinned) render(null);
  });

  // Keyboard focus, delegated the same way.
  list.addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
    var chip = chipFrom(e.target);
    if (chip && !pinned) render(chip);
  });
  list.addEventListener("focusout", function (e) {
    if (!pinned && !list.contains(e.relatedTarget)) render(null);
  });

  for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
    chips[i].addEventListener("click", function () {
      pin(pinned === this ? null : this);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && pinned) pin(null);
  });

  var resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(reserveHeight, 150);
  });

  reserveHeight();
  window.addEventListener("load", reserveHeight);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    document.fonts.ready.then(reserveHeight).catch(function () {});
  }
})();
</script>
